body.en:
A self-drilling screw, usually called a TEK screw in the trade, carries its own drill point at the tip. The point cuts the pilot hole as the screw turns, the thread taps the material behind it, and the assembly is complete in one operation with no separate drilling step. That single feature is the whole commercial case for the part: on steel framing, cladding, ducting, racking and light structural work it removes a tool change and a second pass, and on thin sheet it removes the risk of drilling a hole that is too large for the thread to grip.

The drill point is the part that decides where the screw can be used. Points are numbered by the thickness of steel they will penetrate, and a screw with a point sized for thin sheet will fail on heavier section while a screw with a point sized for heavy section will over-cut thin sheet and strip the thread. Suppliers describe this with the point number, and buyers who specify only a diameter and a length are specifying half a product.

The head forms divide the market into three practical groups. A hex washer head with a bonded sealing washer is the standard for roofing and cladding, where the washer is the water seal and the hex drive gives positive torque transfer. A pan or wafer head with a Phillips or square drive suits light sheet and general fabrication, where a low profile matters. A countersunk head suits work where the surface must finish flush, and it needs a matching countersink in the material rather than relying on the screw to draw itself in.

Two limits are worth stating plainly. A self-drilling screw is not a structural bolt: it does not develop the preload of a graded hex bolt and should not be substituted for one in a calculated connection. And its corrosion performance is set by the coating, not by the drill point, so a screw chosen for its drilling behaviour still has to be chosen again for the environment it will live in.

That is why the point number, not the diameter, is the first thing an experienced buyer asks for.

body.en:
There is no published price list for TEK screws, and any fixed number printed on a page is a snapshot of one specification in one week rather than a price a buyer can transact on. What can be explained precisely is how a FOB China quotation is built, because that structure is stable even when the numbers move.

The base is the wire and the forming: a screw of a given diameter, length and point costs what the wire costs plus what the cold heading, thread rolling and heat treatment cost. Diameter and length set the mass, so they set most of the base; the point and the thread pitch add tooling cost and reduce line speed. A screw with a fine thread for thin sheet, or a point for heavy section, is a slower part to make than a general-purpose one, and that appears in the price rather than in the specification sheet.

The coating is the second layer and often the largest single addition. Zinc plating to a stated thickness, mechanically applied zinc, zinc flake with a defined coating class, or hot-dip galvanising each carry a different cost and a different corrosion life. A quotation that says "galvanised" without a coating class has quoted the process and not the product, and the cheapest interpretation is usually what will be delivered.

The third layer is the accessories and the packing. A bonded EPDM sealing washer, a separate washer, a cap or a colour-matched head each add material cost and an assembly step. Packing is a real line item too: small boxes, printed cartons, palletisation and labelling all carry cost, and the difference between a bulk carton and a retail-ready box can matter as much as a coating upgrade on a small order. The fourth layer is freight and the document package, which move the price from FOB to delivered, and the fifth is the volume and payment terms, because a container order placed against a schedule is a different commercial proposition from an urgent part-container.

自钻螺丝没有公开价目表，任何页面上固定的数字都只是某一规格在某一周的切片，不能当作可以成交的价格。可以讲清楚的是上海或宁波离岸价的构成，因为结构稳定，数字才会变。

第一层是原材料与成型：给定直径、长度和钻点的螺丝，成本来自线材，加上冷镦、搓丝与热处理。直径和长度决定单重，也就决定了基价的主体；钻点与螺纹牙距会增加工装成本、降低线速，所以细牙或厚板钻点的螺丝比通用规格更慢，这份差价体现在价格里而不是规格书里。

第二层是表面处理，往往也是单项加价最大的一层。按厚度声明的镀锌、机械镀锌、按涂层等级声明的锌铝涂层、热浸镀锌，成本和耐蚀寿命各不相同。报价只写"镀锌"而不写涂层等级，等于只报了工艺、没报产品，而最终交付的通常是最便宜的那种理解。

第三层是配件与包装。EPDM 密封垫圈、另配平垫、装饰盖、同色头型，都增加材料成本与一道装配工序。包装也是实打实的一项：小盒、彩箱、托盘化、贴标都要钱，散装大箱与零售包装的差价，在小单上可能和一次涂层升级差不多。第四层是运费与单证，决定从离岸价到到岸价；第五层是数量与付款条件，因为按排期下的整柜订单和急用的拼柜，本来就是两门生意。

Lo que sí puede explicarse con precisión es cómo se construye una cotización FOB China, porque esa estructura permanece estable aunque los números se muevan.

La cotización de este producto se construye a partir de una estructura, no de una lista de precios. El precio de cada lote combina el precio base de material y conformado, el recargo por acabado superficial y clase de recubrimiento, el embalaje y los accesorios, el transporte interior hasta el puerto, el flete marítimo y los documentos de exportación, y los ajustes por cantidad y condiciones de pago. Los insumos que más mueven el precio son acero, zinc, energía y flete, y se recalculan por lote; cualquier cifra publicada en una página es un corte de una semana, no un precio negociable. Las comparaciones solo valen a igual especificación, igual Incoterm e igual embalaje. Indíquenos medida, recubrimiento, embalaje, cantidad, puerto de destino e Incoterm y le preparamos una cotización verificable.

body.en:
Volume pricing in this trade is not a discount schedule printed on a page; it is a negotiation about how much of the fixed cost the buyer is willing to absorb. The fixed costs are the setup, the tooling if the part is non-standard, the packing run, the documentation and the booking. Spread over a small order they dominate the unit price; spread over a container they nearly disappear, which is why two quotes for the same screw can differ by a factor that has nothing to do with the screw.

The practical hierarchy is straightforward. A full container of one line is the cheapest per unit, because setup and packing are amortised over the largest quantity and the loading is simple. A mixed container of several lines is slightly more expensive per unit but far more useful to a distributor, because it delivers a range rather than a stock problem. A part-container or an LCL shipment is the most expensive per unit and is worth it only when the alternative is a stopped line.

Three habits make a volume negotiation work. Consolidate the sizes so that the order is deep rather than wide. Fix the specification — diameter, length, point, thread, coating class, washer — before the price is discussed, so that both sides are pricing the same part. And separate the price from the terms: a lower unit price on advance payment and a higher one on terms are different offers, and the comparison should be landed cost against a named Incoterm and a named payment condition.

The last point is the one buyers most often skip: ask what is not included. Certification, third-party inspection, pallet marking, a specific carton print, or a sealing washer to a defined hardness are all items that a quotation can leave out quietly, and each of them comes back as a cost at the moment the goods are ready to ship.

The specification of a TEK screw is a short list, but every item on it changes what the part will do. Diameter and length define the mass and the reach. The drill point number defines the steel thickness the screw can penetrate. The thread — coarse for timber and thin sheet, fine for metal-to-metal — defines the grip. The head form defines the drive, the bearing surface and whether a sealing washer can be fitted. The coating class defines the corrosion life, and the base material defines the strength.

Strength is usually declared through the case hardness of the point and the core strength of the body, because a self-drilling screw has to be hard enough to cut and tough enough not to snap. A part that is hard all the way through drills well and fails brittle; a part that is soft drills badly and strips. The heat treatment is therefore the quality control that matters most, and it is the one a buyer cannot see. Asking for the hardness range in the certificate is the practical way to make it visible.

Dimensional tolerances matter for the same reason they do on any threaded part: a screw that is at the top of the diameter tolerance will not enter a hole that a screw at the bottom of it will, and on automated equipment that difference stops a line. Where a project specifies a standard, the supplier should confirm which standard and which tolerance class, and where it does not, the buyer should expect the supplier's house tolerance rather than assume a default.

Testing is proportionate. A dimensional check, a point hardness check, a coating thickness measurement and a drive test into the specified steel thickness will confirm a shipment faster than any document review, and they can be done with the tools already on site. The certificate then becomes a record of what was tested rather than a substitute for testing.

One more specification habit worth keeping: write the point number and the coating class on the purchase order, not in an email, because those two items are what a buyer will need to prove when a shipment arrives that drills badly or rusts early.

A rastreabilidade do material é outro aspecto crítico: cada lote deve vir com um certificado de teste de fábrica (MTC) que documente a composição química, propriedades mecânicas e tratamento de superfície. Para aplicações críticas, a rastreabilidade lote a lote é essencial para recalls e análise de falhas. A documentação deve incluir relatórios de teste de tração, dureza, análise química e teste de névoa salina quando aplicável. O revestimento de superfície deve ser verificado quanto à espessura, aderência e uniformidade. Parafusos com revestimento irregular ou abaixo da espessura especificada falharão prematuramente em serviço, especialmente em ambientes corrosivos. A verificação da precisão dimensional inclui diâmetro da rosca, passo, comprimento, geometria da ponta de broca e concentricidade da cabeça. Desvios dimensionais podem causar problemas de instalação, redução da força de extração e falha prematura. Inspecione amostras de cada lote usando paquímetros calibrados, medidores de rosca e projetores ópticos para componentes críticos. A buyer comparing TEK screws should start from the joint rather than the price. What is the steel thickness at the point of penetration, what load does the fixing carry, what will the surface be exposed to, and will the assembly ever be opened again? Those four answers set the point, the diameter, the coating and the head, and only then does the quotation make sense.

On the commercial side, the request for quotation should carry the full specification, the quantity per size, the packing requirement, the destination and the Incoterm. A quotation built on that is comparable with another built on the same; a quotation built on "TEK screws, box of 100" is comparable with nothing, and the differences will be discovered at goods-in rather than at the desk.

On delivery, the realistic question is lead time against a schedule. Standard lines from stock move quickly; a non-standard length, a specific coating class or a printed carton adds a production slot that has to be planned. Asking for the producing date rather than the shipping date is the habit that keeps a project on schedule, because the shipping date is the one that can slip without anyone noticing.

Finally, keep the sample. A screw that was approved, measured and driven into the specified steel is the reference for every later shipment, and a retained sample is the cheapest quality system a buyer can run. When a later batch arrives that "looks the same", the sample is what settles the question.

a.zh: 自钻螺钉尾部自带钻尖，一次完成钻孔与攻丝，省去单独钻孔工序，报价结构在钢材价格波动时依然稳定。底价是线材与成型成本，随直径、长度、钻尾号与头型变化；镀层是最大变量，AZ150 及以上明显贵于薄电镀锌，不锈钢再高一档；螺纹粗牙配木材与薄板，细牙配金属对金属。整柜与混托、是否配密封垫圈也影响报价。固定价目表只是某规格某一周的快照，比价应按每千件到岸成本；降本靠收敛长度与镀层规格、延长生产批次，而不单靠压数量。
a.hi: स्पेसिफिकेशन, उपयोग और उचित क्रय पद्धति की पूरी समीक्षा लेख के मुख्य भाग में दी गई है। चयन से पहले अपने काम की सामग्री, धागा माप, कोटिंग और मात्रा के हिसाब से वहां की जानकारी मिलाकर देखें; ठोस भाव ऑर्डर की विशिष्टता पर बनता है, और कोई भी ग्रेड या सतह साइट की परिस्थिति के अनुसार ही चुनी जाए।
a.ru: Саморез с буром на конце нарезает отверстие сам: сверлящая часть формирует пилотное отверстие при вращении, резьба сразу нарезает материал, и сборка завершается одним проходом без отдельного сверления. Главный практический эффект на стальном каркасе, обшивке, воздуховодах, стеллажах и лёгких конструкциях — меньше смен инструмента и второго прохода, а на тонком листе снижается риск просверлить отверстие крупнее, чем держит резьба.
a.ar: تُقيم القائمة من عناصرها المكونة: المادة والطلاء، والقطر والطول، ونوع الرأس، ونمط الشحن. افحص السعر على أساس التكلفة النهائية لكل ألف قطعة لا للوحدة، وطابق المواصفات مع متطلب المشروع قبل المقارنة بين الموردين. اطلب تفصيل تكلفة الطلاء وعبء التجهيز، واحسب هامش الكمية والحاوية كاملة.
a.es: Un tornillo autoperforante, llamado TEK en el oficio, lleva su propia punta de taladro en la extremidad: la punta abre el agujero piloto mientras el tornillo gira, la rosca rosca el material detrás y el ensamblaje queda en una operación. No existe una tarifa publicada fija; lo que se explica con precisión es cómo se construye una cotización FOB China, a partir de especificación, material y volumen.
a.fr: Commencez par le joint : épaisseur d'acier au point de perçage, charge reprise, exposition de surface, et possibilité de rouvrir l'assemblage. Ces quatre réponses déterminent la pointe, le diamètre, le revêtement et la tête. Côté commercial, la demande doit porter la spécification complète, la quantité par taille, l'emballage, la destination et l'Incoterm. Une cotation bâtie sur ces éléments est comparable à une autre.
a.pt: Este guia reúne especificações, aplicações e boas práticas para a lista de preços de parafusos autoperfurantes TEK, conforme a análise acima. A comparação de preços exige conferir classe, revestimento, diâmetro, comprimento, tipo de cabeça e Incoterm, não apenas o número unitário. Duas ofertas só são comparáveis quando descrevem o mesmo fixador, e a ficha de especificação acompanha a proposta antes do pedido em volume.

q.en: What drives the price of self-drilling screws?
q.zh: 自钻螺钉价格由什么决定？

a.en: Coating is the biggest variable: AZ150 or higher adds real cost over thin electro-zinc, and stainless multiplies it again. Then diameter and length, head type, and whether the order is a full container or a mixed pallet.
a.zh: 镀层影响最大：AZ150 及以上比薄电镀锌明显更贵，不锈钢再翻一档。其次是直径与长度、头型，以及订单是整柜还是拼托。
a.hi: कोटिंग सबसे बड़ा बदलाव वाला पहलू है: पतले इलेक्ट्रो-ज़िंक के मुकाबले AZ150 या उससे ऊपर कोटिंग में असली खर्च आता है, और स्टेनलेस स्टील उस पर फिर एक दर ज़्यादा करता है। इसके बाद व्यास व लंबाई, हेड का प्रकार, और ऑर्डर पूरे कंटेनर का है या मिला-जुला पैलेट, ये बातें भी भाव में बदलाव लाती हैं; कीमत इन्हीं पर मिलकर बनती है, इसलिए पहले स्पेसिफिकेशन साफ करें।
a.ru: Больше всего колеблет себестоимость покрытие: AZ150 и выше заметно дороже тонкого электролитического цинка, а нержавеющая сталь умножает цену ещё раз. Дальше в порядке влияния идут диаметр и длина, тип головки и характер заказа — полный контейнер или сборный паллет. Конкретная ставка фиксируется после согласования спецификации и объёма партии.
a.ar: الطلاء هو المتغير الأكبر: AZ150 أو أعلى يضيف تكلفة حقيقية فوق الزنك الكهربائي الرقيق، والفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ يضاعفها مرة أخرى. ثم يأتي القطر والطول ونوع الرأس، وما إذا كان الطلب حاوية كاملة أم منصة مختلطة. يعتمد السعر على الكمية والمقاس والطلاء معًا، لا على بند واحد منفرد.
a.es: El recubrimiento es la variable mayor: un AZ150 o superior añade coste real frente al zincado eléctrico fino, y el inoxidable lo multiplica de nuevo. Después entran diámetro y longitud, tipo de cabeza, y si el pedido es un contenedor completo o un palé mixto. La especulación sobre una tarifa fija no sustituye a la cotización contra ficha escrita.
a.fr: Le revêtement est la variable la plus forte : un AZ150 ou supérieur ajoute un coût réel par rapport au zinc électrolytique mince, et l'inox le multiplie encore. Viennent ensuite le diamètre et la longueur, le type de tête, et le fait que la commande soit un conteneur complet ou une palette mélangée. Le fil d'acier et la quantité de zinc montent avec la masse de chaque vis. Comparez toujours sur une spécification écrite.
a.pt: O revestimento é a maior variável: AZ150 ou superior acrescenta custo real sobre a eletrozincagem fina, e o inoxidável multiplica de novo. Depois vêm diâmetro e comprimento, tipo de cabeça, e se o pedido é contêiner cheio ou palete misto. A análise separa matéria-prima, tratamento de superfície e condição de embarque, para que a cotação reflita o fixador efetivamente entregue.

a.en: FOB excludes ocean freight and destination charges; CIF adds freight and insurance to a named port, which for African routes can be a meaningful share of the unit price on heavy screws. Compare landed cost per thousand pieces, not per unit FOB.
a.zh: FOB 不含海运费与目的港费用；CIF 加运费与保险到指定港，非洲航线对重的螺钉来说这部分占比不小。要按每千支的到岸成本比价，而不是比 FOB 单价。
a.hi: एफओबी में समुद्री ढुलाई और गंतव्य शुल्क शामिल नहीं होते; सीआईएफ में बताए गए बंदरगाह तक माल ढुलाई व बीमा जुड़ जाता है, और अफ्रीका रूट पर भारी स्क्रू में यह हिस्सा इकाई भाव का बड़ा अंश हो सकता है। तुलना प्रति हजार पीस की लैंडेड लागत से करें, सिर्फ एफओबी इकाई भाव से नहीं; बीमा व बंदरगाह खर्च भी गिनने पर ही असली फर्क दिखता है।
a.ru: FOB не включает морскую перевозку и платежи в порту назначения; CIF добавляет фрахт и страховку до указанного порта, и на африканских направлениях у тяжёлых саморезов эта доля в цене единицы заметна. Сравнивать предложения нужно по привозной стоимости на тысячу штук, а не по цене за штуку на условиях FOB.
a.ar: FOB يستبعد الشحن البحري ورسوم الوجهة؛ وCIF يضيف الشحن والتأمين إلى ميناء مسمى، وهو ما قد يشكل حصة ملموسة من سعر الوحدة في المسارات الأفريقية للبراغي الثقيلة. قارن التكلفة الأرضية لكل ألف قطعة، لا سعر الوحدة عند FOB. حدد المصطلح في الاستفسار حتى تكون المقارنة بين العروض متساوية.
a.es: FOB excluye el flete marítimo y los gastos de destino; CIF añade flete y seguro hasta un puerto designado, lo que en rutas africanas puede ser una parte apreciable del precio unitario en tornillos pesados. Conviene comparar el coste por millar de piezas landed, no por unidad FOB. El desglose de flete se pide al proveedor antes de cerrar la oferta.
a.fr: Le FOB exclut le fret maritime et les frais de destination ; le CIF ajoute fret et assurance jusqu'au port désigné, ce qui, sur les routes africaines, peut représenter une part notable du prix unitaire pour des vis lourdes. Comparez le coût livré par mille pièces, et non le prix FOB à l'unité. Demandez la ventilation du fret lorsque vous comparez deux fournisseurs. Le choix dépend aussi de votre propre commissionnaire.
a.pt: O FOB exclui frete marítimo e encargos de destino; o CIF acrescenta frete e seguro a um porto nomeado, o que nas rotas africanas pode ser parcela relevante do preço unitário em parafusos pesados. Compara-se o custo landed por mil peças, não o preço unitário FOB. Na comparação entre fornecedores, pede-se o detalhamento do frete, e o seguro e o manuseio portuário são separados na conta.

q.en: Do larger orders really lower the unit price?
q.zh: 大订单真的能降单价吗？
q.hi: बड़े ऑर्डर से इकाई भाव सचमुच घटता है?

a.en: Partly. Set-up and coating batch costs are spread over more pieces, but steel and zinc costs scale linearly. The biggest savings come from standardising a few lengths and coatings so the factory runs longer campaigns, not from pushing quantity alone.
a.zh: 部分能。开机与镀层批次成本被摊薄，但钢材与锌的成本是线性增长的。真正的降本来自把长度与镀层规格收敛到少数几种、让产线跑更长批次，而不仅是压数量。
a.hi: कुछ हद तक। सेट-अप और कोटिंग बैच की लागत ज़्यादा पीस में बंट जाती है, लेकिन स्टील और ज़िंक का खर्च सीधे मात्रा के अनुपात में बढ़ता है। सबसे बड़ी बचत कुछ लंबाई व कोटिंग को एकरूप करके मिलती है, ताकि फैक्ट्री लंबे बैच चला सके; अकेले मात्रा बढ़ाने से वह बचत नहीं आती, इसलिए स्पेसिफिकेशन की मानकीकरण योजना पहले बनाएं।
a.ru: Частично. Наладка и стоимость партии покрытия распределяются на большее число изделий, но сталь и цинк растут пропорционально весу. Главная экономика даёт не сам объём, а стандартизация нескольких длин и покрытий: тогда завод ведёт длинные производственные кампании, и себестоимость позиции падает.
a.ar: جزئيًا. تكاليف التجهيز ودفعة الطلاء تتوزع على قطع أكثر، لكن تكلفة الفولاذ والزنك تتناسب خطيًا. أكبر وفرة تأتي من توحيد أطوال وطلاءات قليلة حتى تدور المصنع حملات إنتاج أطول، لا من دفع الكمية وحدها. اطلب تسعيرًا على أساس المواصفات الموحدة والمجموعة في حاوية كاملة.
a.es: En parte. Los costes de puesta en marcha y de lote de recubrimiento se reparten entre más piezas, pero el acero y el zinc escalan linealmente. El mayor ahorro viene de estandarizar unas pocas longitudes y recubrimientos para que la fábrica haga campañas más largas, no de empujar la cantidad por sí sola.
a.fr: En partie. Les frais de mise en route et de lot de revêtement se répartissent sur plus de pièces, mais les coûts d'acier et de zinc progressent linéairement. L'économie la plus forte vient de la standardisation de quelques longueurs et revêtements, pour que l'usine lance des campagnes plus longues, plutôt que de pousser la quantité seule. Un mélange trop large de références limite cet effet. Regroupez les tailles tournantes dans une même série.
a.pt: Em parte. Os custos de preparo e de lote de revestimento são diluídos entre mais peças, mas os custos de aço e zinco crescem linearmente. A maior economia vem de padronizar poucos comprimentos e revestimentos para que a fábrica rode campanhas mais longas, não de empurrar quantidade isoladamente. A negociação de volume deve vir acompanhada de especificação fechada e lote rastreável.
